benefits: Funding of up to ₹20 Lakhs as a grant for validation of proof of concept, prototype development, or product trials. Up to ₹50 Lakhs investment via convertible debentures or debt for market entry, commercialization, or scaling.
eligibility: DPIIT-recognized startup incorporated not more than 2 years ago, with a viable business model, commercial capability, and using technology.
description: Provides financial assistance to startups for proof of concept, prototype development, product trials, market entry, and commercialization, enabling them to reach a stage where they can raise debt or venture capital.

benefits: Grant-in-aid of up to ₹50 Lakhs for a duration of 18 months, along with mentorship, access to bio-incubators, and networking opportunities.
eligibility: Biotech startup incorporated not more than 5 years ago, or an individual entrepreneur with a scientific background having a novel biotech idea.
description: Supports early-stage scientific ideas and discoveries in biotechnology, medical devices, agriculture, and industrial biotech, helping transform them into commercial products.

benefits: Funding support of up to ₹40 Lakhs per startup matching the investment raised through accelerators, along with cohort training, valuation assistance, and customer access.
eligibility: Software product startup at the MVP stage or beyond, with customer traction and ready to raise external investment.
description: Supports software startups with mentorship, customer connections, and matching-fund investments through designated partner accelerators to scale globally.

scheme_name: SIDBI Fund of Funds for Startups (FFS)
benefits: Indirect equity investment capital through SEBI-registered Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs) that invest in early to growth stage startups.
eligibility: DPIIT-registered Indian startups seeking institutional equity rounds (Series A, B, etc.).
description: An operational fund established by the Government of India with a corpus of ₹10,000 Crores, managed by SIDBI, which invests in VC funds to channel capital into high-growth startups.

benefits: Financial assistance of up to ₹15 Lakhs per approved idea for developing prototypes or proofs of concept. Mentorship and incubation support.
eligibility: Any individual, student, or registered MSME with a novel, innovative solution addressable via manufacturing or local enterprise.
description: Encourages adoption of innovative ideas and technology among MSMEs, hosting national level hackathons to seed and fund manufacturing and rural business concepts.

benefits: Seed funding of up to ₹25 Lakhs per startup, monthly internship stipends of ₹20,000 for early innovators, cloud credits, incubation space, and advisory support.
eligibility: Startups working in identified focus areas (like remote work, edu-tech, agri-tech, medical electronics) incorporated under MCA rules.
description: A startup challenge contest under the Next Generation Incubation Scheme (NGIS) aiming to scout and support technology startups in tier-2 and tier-3 cities.

benefits: Direct workspace access, labs, expert mentorship, corporate connect, and seed funding of up to ₹10 Lakhs during incubation.
eligibility: Early-stage innovators, researchers, or startups needing infrastructure, mentorship, and development support.
description: Fosters innovation and entrepreneurship by establishing world-class incubators (Atal Incubation Centres) across universities and corporations in India.

benefits: Grant of up to ₹10 Lakhs to individual innovators for converting physical ideas into physical prototypes. Fabrication lab access and technical mentoring.
eligibility: Individual student, scientist, researcher, or early startup (incorporated less than 3 years) focused on hardware innovations.
description: Supports young and aspiring innovators by providing financial grants to build physical prototypes, bridging the gap between an idea and a proof of concept.

benefits: Financial assistance of ₹10 Lakhs to ₹1 Crore for product commercialization, marketing, and operational expenses in exchange for minimal equity or low-interest debt.
eligibility: Startups incubated in a recognized DST-TBI (Technology Business Incubator) for at least 3 months, with a validated product/MVP.
description: Provides early-stage seed funding to startups incubated in DST-supported TBIs to help them transition from prototype/MVP to scaling and commercialization.

benefits: Bank loans between ₹10 Lakhs and ₹1 Crore covering up to 75% of project cost, with low interest rates and repayment period of up to 7 years.
eligibility: Startups or businesses where at least one Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) or woman entrepreneur holds minimum 51% shareholding.
description: Promotes entrepreneurship at the grassroots level by focusing on economic empowerment of SC, ST, and women entrepreneurs through bank finance.

benefits: Equity or debt funding between ₹15 Lakhs and ₹50 Lakhs for early-stage startups, along with workspace at T-Hub and corporate mentorship.
eligibility: Startups registered or based in Telangana with an innovative product and technical feasibility.
description: An early-stage seed fund co-funded by the Government of Telangana and private VCs, aiming to support innovative startups with scale-up capital.

benefits: Grant and seed funding up to ₹10 Lakhs for validation, scaling, and market access, alongside dedicated incubation space for women-led startups.
eligibility: Startups with at least 51% female ownership or led by a woman founder, operating or registered in Telangana.
description: Fosters women-led entrepreneurship in India by providing access to technical mentoring, infrastructure, and early-stage capital via the WE Hub incubator.

benefits: Seed grant of up to ₹5 Lakhs for proof-of-concept validation, prototype development, or initial testing, and fast-track incubation entry.
eligibility: Startups registered with APIS, having a registered office in Andhra Pradesh, and working on an innovative product.
description: Supports early-stage entrepreneurs in Andhra Pradesh with financial assistance to turn creative concepts into functional prototypes.

ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefits: 3% interest subvention per annum on bank loans up to ₹2 Crores, credit guarantee coverage through CGTMSE, and long repayment tenure up to 7 years.
eligibility: Agri-tech startups, farmers, primary agricultural credit societies (PACS), and agricultural entrepreneurs.
description: A medium-long term debt financing facility for investment in viable projects for post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets.

ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefits: Grants of up to ₹5 Lakhs for pre-seed/ideation stage and up to ₹25 Lakhs for seed-stage startups, along with 8-week structured residency training.
eligibility: Indian startups operating in agriculture, food processing, animal husbandry, or allied sectors with commercial viability.
description: Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana - Remunerative Approaches for Agriculture and Allied Sectors Rejuvenation (RKVY-RAFTAAR) supports agri-entrepreneurs with incubation and capital grants.

benefits: Financial support of ₹4 Lakhs (for ideation) to ₹7 Lakhs (for prototyping) via TBIs, access to digital fabrication labs, and workspace support.
eligibility: ICT startups or student entrepreneurs working on tech-enabled solutions utilizing emerging technologies (AI, Blockchain, IoT, etc.).
description: Technology Incubation and Development of Entrepreneurs (TIDE 2.0) promotes tech entrepreneurship by providing financial and technical assistance through 51 TBIs.

benefits: Collateral-free business credit or loans of up to ₹5 Crores from partner financial institutions, with credit guarantee coverage up to 85% of the loan amount.
eligibility: New and existing micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs) including tech startups with active service delivery.
description: Provides credit guarantees to financial institutions, encouraging them to lend collateral-free credit to MSMEs and small businesses.

benefits: Financial reimbursement of up to ₹15 Lakhs per international patent application filed, or 50% of the actual expenditure, whichever is less.
eligibility: DPIIT-registered technology/ICT startups or MSMEs with a filed Indian patent application or positive search report.
description: Support for International Patent Protection in E&IT (SIP-EIT) provides financial support to MSMEs and technology startups for international patent filings.

benefits: Access to training, business development resources, and seed funding of up to ₹8 Lakhs to set up innovative rural enterprises.
eligibility: Rural youth, entrepreneurs, and startups focusing on agro-industries and innovative manufacturing in rural areas.
description: A Scheme for Promotion of Innovation, Rural Industries and Entrepreneurship (ASPIRE) aims to set up Livelihood Business Incubators (LBI) and fund rural innovation.

benefits: Collateral-free institutional bank loans across three categories: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishor (₹50,000 to ₹5 Lakhs), and Tarun (₹5 Lakhs to ₹10 Lakhs).
eligibility: Any non-farm, non-corporate micro/small enterprise or individual seeking business capital.
description: Provides low-interest, collateral-free loans to micro and small enterprises to fund their working capital, infrastructure, and business expansion requirements.

benefits: Credit-linked capital subsidy of 35% of eligible project cost with a maximum ceiling of ₹10 Lakhs per unit, along with marketing and branding support.
eligibility: Micro food processing enterprises, self-help groups (SHGs), cooperatives, and agri-tech startup processors.
description: Supports the formalization, modernization, and technical upgrade of unorganized individual micro food processing enterprises.

benefits: Financial support of up to ₹2 Lakhs (Phase-I, Category-I for ideation) and up to ₹20 Lakhs (Phase-I, Category-II for prototyping and scaling). Phase-II provides up to ₹50 Lakhs for enterprise setup.
eligibility: Individual Indian citizens, researchers, or independent innovators looking to commercialize a physical invention.
description: Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs (PRISM) supports individual innovators to develop state-of-the-art technology solutions.

benefits: Interest-free loan matching the promoter equity or up to 26% of project cost (max ₹75 Lakhs) to assist in setting up agri-business ventures.
eligibility: Individual entrepreneurs, startups, partnerships, or companies setting up agri-business projects with backward integration to farmers.
description: Provides interest-free venture capital assistance to promoters to meet capital gaps in setting up agricultural and food-processing businesses.

ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefits: Funding support of up to ₹30 Lakhs over 3 years as equity/grant through Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes (VCF-SC), plus incubation access.
eligibility: Startups led by SC entrepreneurs or SC youth incubated in technology business incubators (TBIs) for at least 1 month.
description: Supports social sector innovations, promotes entrepreneurship among SC youth, and helps SC-led startups scale using modern technology.

benefits: Access to plug-and-play research infrastructure, advanced testing labs, legal support, regulatory guidance, and networking opportunities.
eligibility: Life sciences, medical devices, bio-tech, and pharma startups in need of dedicated wet laboratory infrastructure.
description: Establishes and supports bio-incubators (BioNEST) across India, providing biotech entrepreneurs with high-end capital infrastructure and incubation space.

benefits: Grants of up to ₹10 Crores to cover R&D costs for telecom hardware/software, along with intellectual property mentoring and pilot test-bed access.
eligibility: Indian startups, companies, or academic consortia working on indigenous telecom innovations (like 5G, 6G, and satellite tech).
description: Supports domestic R&D, product development, and commercialization of telecommunication technologies to build a secure indigenous telecom ecosystem.

benefits: Exemption from Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) in government tenders, free tender sets, and priority in government procurement allocation (minimum 25%).
eligibility: Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) holding a valid Udyam Registration certificate, active in manufacturing or service operations.
description: Registers MSEs with NSIC to facilitate their participation in Government Procurement and PSU tenders, enhancing their sales and bidding capability.

benefits: 100% foreign equity allowance, duty-free import of hardware, high-speed data communication links, and tax benefits on software exports.
eligibility: Software development or IT services companies and startups registered with STPI engaging in software export operations.
description: Promotes software exports from India by providing regulatory support, state-of-the-art incubation, and duty-free import facilities under a single window.

benefits: Funding support to participate in domestic and international trade fairs and exhibitions, covering stall rent, travel costs, and promotional print charges.
eligibility: Registered MSMEs and tech product startups looking to showcase products in national or international markets.
description: Enhances the marketing capabilities and competitiveness of MSMEs by facilitating their participation in exhibitions, tech expos, and buyer-seller meets.

benefits: Financial assistance, validation testing, patent filing support, and product commercialization grants of up to ₹5 Lakhs for grassroots innovations.
eligibility: Grassroots innovators, rural youth, and independent self-taught technicians with an innovative non-traditional technology solution.
description: Identifies, supports, and documents grassroots technological innovations and outstanding traditional knowledge from rural India.

benefits: Full research grant covering high-end laboratory equipment, research assistant salaries, consumable costs, and international collaboration funding.
eligibility: Academic researchers, scientists, or startups collaborating with Indian research labs, pursuing path-breaking scientific concepts.
description: Supports research proposals that are conceptually new, high-risk, and have potential to result in paradigm-shifting technological breakthroughs.

benefits: Financial grant of up to ₹2 Lakhs per innovator, prototype validation at government labs, and exhibition booths at state startup meets.
eligibility: Student innovators, grassroots/rural entrepreneurs, and early-stage social impact startups based in Telangana.
description: Supports grassroots innovations and student inventions in Telangana by providing early prototype capital, mentoring, and marketing exposure.

benefits: Total funding support of up to ₹25 Lakhs per startup, digital credentials access, sandbox environments, and corporate matchmaking programs.
eligibility: Technology startups from tier-2 and tier-3 cities in India leveraging ICT to solve national or regional challenges.
description: Gen-Next Support for Innovative Startups (GENESIS) aims to discover, support, and grow tech startups in non-metropolitan regions of India.

benefits: Academic Research Conversion Grants of up to ₹50 Lakhs (for proof-of-concept) and soft loans of up to ₹1 Crore (for commercialization).
eligibility: Indian biotechnology companies/startups in collaboration with an academic partner or university lab.
description: Promoting Academic Research Conversion to Enterprise (PACE) encourages startups to collaborate with academia to translate scientific research into products.

benefits: Mentorship from global corporate partners, co-working space credits, pitch preparation, investor access sessions, and tech vendor credits (AWS, Google Cloud).
eligibility: Early to growth stage technology startups willing to operate from or base operations in Hyderabad, Telangana.
description: T-Hub is one of India's leading startup incubators, providing tech startups with a vibrant ecosystem, resources, and connections to grow rapidly.
